title: Canada's Charter protects life, liberty, and security of the person, and deprivation only in accordance with fundamental justice
summary: Canada's Charter protects life, liberty, and security of the person, and deprivation only in accordance with fundamental justice.
body: Section 7 says everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of the person and the right not to be deprived thereof except in accordance with the principles of fundamental justice. The source says: "Legal Rights Marginal note: Life, liberty and security of person 7 Everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of the person and the right not to be deprived thereof except in accordance with the principles of fundamental justice." The standard written in the section is the principles of fundamental justice. The card does not restate the case law that has applied it.
